name: Nimrod
overview: Scripture presents Nimrod as a significant post-Flood figure, the son of Cush, who became a mighty leader on the earth. He is described as "a mighty hunter before the LORD," highlighting his strength and prominence. Nimrod is also credited with founding key cities in the land of Shinar, including Babel (Babylon), marking the beginning of his kingdom and influence. These details emphasize Nimrod's role in early human history as a powerful ruler and city-builder.
